references.text: The Israelites forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the Asherah poles, showing the same pattern of forgetting God.
Moses warns the Israelites not to forget the Lord who brought them out of Egypt, which is directly relevant to the warning in Judges.
The warning that when they are full and well off, they must not forget the Lord who brought them out of Egypt.
The psalm describes how Israel forgot God their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt and at the Red Sea.
The next generation did not know the Lord and did what was evil in the Lord's sight, the same theme of forgetting God.
The preceding verse tells that Israel turned to Baal idols right after Gideon's death, providing context for their forgetting the Lord.
Samuel reminds the people that they forgot the Lord their God, so he handed them over into the hands of their enemies, but saved them when they cried out to him.
Jeremiah asks if a virgin can forget her jewelry, yet my people have forgotten me in countless days.
